company_name: Avino Silver & Gold Mines Ltd. Common Shares (Canada)
title: Avino is integrating VRIFY's DORA AI platform
body_markdown:
Discover Avino's growth story - from its founding in 1968 to becoming a low-cost silver producer with a clear path to transformational growth.


‍


Producing ~2.5M silver-equivalent ounces today and targeting 8-10M ounces over the next five years, Avino remains focused on disciplined growth and long-term value creation. This video highlights our high-grade La Preciosa project and how Avino is leveraging innovative tools, including[VRIFY](https://www.linkedin.com/company/vrify/) 's DORA AI platform, to turn complex geological data into actionable exploration targets.


‍


Watch the video:[Avino's Growth Story](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KyJyokBNUIQ)
